summary: 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, two storeys, with a two car garage.

roomList.name: Living room
roomList.note: Open to the second floor above.

roomList.name: Shower room
roomList.note: Shower and toilet, off the primary bath.

tour.say: You're just inside the front door, in the foyer. The foyer is about 14 by 10 feet. The stairs to the second floor are close by, and the living room opens off the foyer with no wall between them.
Living room. About 11 by 14 feet. The ceiling is open all the way to the second floor. Windows face the street along the front wall. The dining area is straight through, past two columns.
Dining area. About 13 by 11 feet, with a bay bumped out of the side wall. A wide opening leads into the kitchen.
Kitchen. About 9 by 13 feet, with an island in the middle and the sink under the back window.
Breakfast nook. About 12 by 13 feet. A sliding door in the back wall leads to the yard. There's no wall between the nook and the family room.
Family room. About 16 by 17 feet, with a fireplace in the far end wall.
Laundry room, about 7 by 8 feet. A door in the far wall goes out to the garage.
Garage. A two car garage, about 23 by 18 feet, concrete. The big garage door is in the front wall.
Back in the foyer, by the front door. The half bath is here, through a small door. The short hall you just walked links the foyer to the kitchen.
Stairs to the second floor. They climb toward the back of the house, then turn.
Top of the stairs. Upstairs hall. Every bedroom and the hall bath open off this hall.
Bedroom 2. About 18 by 13 feet, with a closet, and a door to the attic in the far wall.
Hall bath, about 8 by 7 feet, with a tub.
Primary bedroom. About 16 by 14 feet, with windows on two walls. The primary bath is through a door in the back wall.
Primary bath, about 11 by 8 feet, with a corner tub and two sinks. A walk-in closet opens off one side and the shower room off the other.
Bedroom 3. About 12 by 11 feet, at the front of the house. That's the end of the tour. Explore on your own. Two finger tap asks where you are, and a triple tap points you to the front door.
